# External Recipe/Engines Awesome list

These are not HACK Lab written recipes, but ones you can setup and use on your sparks nonetheless. Great folks building out there and we want to support them. If you have a spark recipe you'd like to see added free to open a PR. We will list it if existing model and setup doesn't exist, or if yours performs better.


# Single Spark - Coding/Text

- [MIA's Deepseek v4 Flash](https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab/DeepSeek-v4-Flash-DSpark-2x-DGX-Spark): DeepSeek-v4-Flash 0731 recipe for 2x DGX Sparks
